title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
纽约布鲁克林区，一个装饰颇为豪华的房间里。陆白整个人被捆绑在椅子上，眼皮有些沉重地睁开了眼睛。“这是哪？！”他昏迷前最后的一段记忆，大概就是今天在公园地摊上，花五十块钱买了一幅画了很多花草鸟兽，据摆摊大爷说是他太爷爷的太爷爷传下来的古画。然后他过马路时就被一辆大货车撞了。“嘶嘶！！”似乎是又回想起了自己被撞那一刻的画面，陆白感觉自己身上疼得厉害。他低头看了看，发现自己被结结实实地捆绑在了一张木椅子上，动弹不得。鼻息间传来了浓浓的血腥味，再一看自己的情况，糟糕透了。白色的亚麻衬衣上有多处血痕，有皮开肉绽的伤口。而更恐怖的是，双手手掌各自被一柄锋利匕首死死钉在了椅子把手上，猩红的血液正潺潺外流，如潮水般的剧痛不断刺痛着他的神经。“我这是......被绑架了？！”来不及多想为什么会有人绑架自己，陆白的目光便瞥到了屋里面那两个面目不善的家伙。一个紫唇黑眼圈的烟熏妆光头壮汉，另一个打着鼻环耳环的脏辫高瘦黑人。并且两人的肤色一黑一白。这样哪来的黑白双煞？？？不知道为什么，陆白竟然没有多少恐惧的情绪。他盯着两人身上朋克风的黑皮衣看了看，又看了一眼他们腰间别着的枪。心里蓦然间浮现出一个大胆的想法：“我好像......穿越了？？”虽然说这个想法很离谱，但却也是最合理的猜测。不然的话。没法解释自己被大卡车撞了之后，为什么还能活下来。而且还不是躺在重症病床上，而是被两个看着像帮派分子的外国人绑在这里折磨。陆白思路清晰地做出这一番推断，然后神情有些莫名地闭上了眼睛。磬！！在他意识集中后，能看到一副古旧的画卷出现在他脑海里。正是他之前在地摊上花五十块买的那幅画。而此时随着一些信息浮现，陆白也知道了这幅画的来历。它是上古时期受轩辕黄帝之请，神兽白泽亲口所述的白泽精怪图。上面记录了山海经中多达一万一千五百二十种异兽。持有此图者，可以自由往返山海世界。并且还可以当面拓印那些异兽或者神兽的天赋能力，并且赋予给其他人。只是这样的做法每一次都需要消耗大量的愿力？？细细体悟这些信息的陆白，很快就掌握了初步使用这白泽精怪图的办法。

他念头一动，积蓄在白泽精怪图内的一丝灰白色气流被调动出来，快速融入他的体内。嘶嘶！！和刚才浑身麻木的疼痛不同，这一次陆白感觉自己的身体好像泡在温泉水里一样，有种发自灵魂的舒适感。他身上的伤势明显开始好转起来，其中一些比较浅的已经开始结疤。并且身体素质似乎也变强了一些。无论是精神还是力量都有所提升。这让陆白因为面对死亡威胁，而紧绷的情绪放松了下来。他闭上眼睛，开始争分夺秒从白泽精怪图里面调动更多的灰白色气流，融入自己身体。“太好了，那小子好像还没死！！”这时房间里那两名正在讨论今晚去哪放松一下的两名外国人中，那名白人光头壮汉回过头来，看到刚才还奄奄一息的肥羊现在好像又有气了，不由得惊喜大喊一声。“嘿，我就知道这些黄皮猴子没有那么容易死，看来我们今晚运气不错。”那名留着脏辫的高瘦黑人闻言转过头，脸上也露出带有一丝狰狞的笑容。他从口袋里掏出一把带着血迹的美工刀，和同伴一起快步走过去。“小子，醒了就别装死了。”脏辫黑人抬手在陆白手臂上重重划了一刀。原以为会跟之前一样，听到这个黄皮猴子美妙的惨叫声。结果这一次。对方却表情异常平静地睁开了眼睛，用一种让脏辫黑人有点害怕的眼神望着他。“该死的黄皮猴子，看来你还没有见识到我的厉害。”反应过来的脏辫黑人有些恼羞成怒，手里的美工刀用力一挥，径直朝着对方的大腿扎去。陆白见此眼睛眯了眯，做出了一个让人匪夷所思的疯狂举动。他没有任何犹豫，猛地抽回了右手。下一瞬，让人汗毛倒竖的‘撕拉’声响起。钉在右手的匕首正好穿透了小指和无名指之间的掌骨缝隙。这一抽，锋利的刀刃直接割断了掌骨间的皮肉，血液飙射而出。“？？？”这一举动，看呆了一旁的光头壮汉。这家伙看着飙射在自己裤腿上的鲜血，瞬间瞪大了眼睛，似乎还在震惊中没回过神来。而就在这时。单手脱困的陆白不顾自己右手上血淋淋的伤口，伸手握着那把钉住自己左手的匕首柄端，将其拔出来，毫不犹豫地捅进了脏辫黑人的心口，然后再拔出来，将其朝着光头壮汉狠狠掷了出去。噗呲！！刚反应过来拔枪的光头壮汉，右眼爆出一团血花。这柄匕首直接穿透了他头骨，力道极重地插在一旁的墙壁上。
content_en:
In a rather luxuriously decorated room in Brooklyn, New York.Lu Bai was tied to the chair and opened his eyes with heavy eyelids."Where is this?!" His last memory before he fell into coma was probably that he spent fifty yuan on a painting of many flowers, plants, birds and animals at a park stall today. According to the stall owner, it was an ancient painting passed down from his great-great-grandfather.Then he was hit by a large truck while crossing the road."Hiss!!" Lu Bai seemed to recall the scene of the moment he was hit, and Lu Bai felt severe pain on his body.He looked down and found that he was tied tightly to a wooden chair and could not move.There was a strong smell of blood in his nose, and when he looked at his condition, it was terrible.There were many blood stains on the white linen shirt, and there were open wounds.What was even more horrifying was that a sharp dagger was nailed to the handle of the chair on each palm of his hands. Scarlet blood was gurgling out, and the sharp pain like a tide kept stinging his nerves."Am I... kidnapped?!" Before he had time to think about why someone would kidnap him, Lu Bai glanced at the two evil-looking guys in the room.There was a bald, muscular man with smoky makeup and purple lips and dark circles, and the other was a tall, thin black man with dreadlocks and a nose ring and earrings.And the skin color of the two of them is black and white.Where does this come from???For some reason, Lu Bai didn't feel much fear.He stared at the punk-style black leather clothes on the two of them, and then at the guns on their waists.A bold idea suddenly emerged in my mind: "I seem to have... traveled through time??" Although this idea was outrageous, it was also the most reasonable guess.otherwise.I can't explain why I survived after being hit by a truck.And he was not lying in a critical hospital bed, but was being tied up and tortured by two foreigners who looked like gang members.Lu Bai made this inference with clear thinking, and then closed his eyes with a somewhat inexplicable expression.Chime!!After he concentrated his consciousness, he could see an ancient picture scroll appearing in his mind.It was the painting he had bought at a street stall for fifty yuan.At this time, as some information emerged, Lu Bai also knew the origin of this painting.It is a picture of Bai Ze's spirit described by the mythical beast Bai Ze himself at the request of Emperor Xuanyuan in ancient times.It records as many as 11,520 kinds of strange beasts in the Classic of Mountains and Seas.Those who hold this map can freely travel to and from the world of mountains and seas.And you can also imprint the talents and abilities of those strange beasts or mythical beasts in person, and give them to other people.Is it just that this approach requires a lot of willpower every time??Lu Bai, who understood this information carefully, quickly mastered the preliminary method of using this Bai Ze spirit map.

As soon as he thought about it, a trace of gray-white air accumulated in the Bai Ze Jinggui figure was mobilized and quickly integrated into his body.Hiss!!Different from the numb pain all over his body just now, this time Lu Bai felt as if his body was soaked in hot spring water, giving him a sense of comfort that came from his soul.The injuries on his body were obviously starting to improve, and some of the more superficial ones had begun to scar.And his physical fitness seems to have become stronger.Both spirit and strength have improved.This made Lu Bai relax his tense emotions due to facing the death threat.He closed his eyes and began to race against time to mobilize more gray-white airflow from the Bai Ze Jinggui Figure and integrate it into his body."Great, that kid doesn't seem to be dead yet!!" At this time, among the two foreigners in the room who were discussing where to relax tonight, the bald white man turned around and saw that the fat sheep who was dying just now seemed to be alive again, and couldn't help shouting in surprise."Hey, I knew these yellow-skinned monkeys wouldn't die that easily. It seems we are lucky tonight." The tall, thin black man with dreadlocks turned his head when he heard this, with a ferocious smile on his face.He took out a bloody utility knife from his pocket and walked quickly over with his companions."Boy, don't pretend to be dead when you wake up." The black man with dreadlocks raised his hand and slashed Lu Bai's arm hard.I thought I would hear the beautiful scream of this yellow-skinned monkey just like before.The result was this time.But the other party opened his eyes with an unusually calm expression and looked at him with a look that made the black man with dreadlocks a little scared."Damn yellow-skinned monkey, it seems you haven't seen how powerful I am." The black man with dreadlocks reacted and became a little angry. He swung the utility knife in his hand hard and pierced the opponent's thigh.Seeing this, Lu Bai narrowed his eyes and made an unbelievable crazy move.Without any hesitation, he suddenly withdrew his right hand.The next moment, a 'tearing' sound sounded that made people's hair stand on end.The dagger nailed to his right hand just penetrated the metacarpal gap between the little finger and ring finger.With this pull, the sharp blade directly cut the flesh between the metacarpal bones, and blood spurted out."???" This move stunned the bald man on the side.The guy's eyes widened instantly when he saw the blood spurting on his trouser legs, as if he was still in shock and had not recovered.And just then.Lu Bai, who escaped with one hand, ignored the bloody wound on his right hand and reached out to hold the handle of the dagger nailed to his left hand. He pulled it out and stabbed it into the heart of the black man with dreadlocks without hesitation. Then he pulled it out and threw it at the bald man.Phew!!The bald man just reacted and drew his gun, and a ball of blood burst out from his right eye.The dagger penetrated directly through his skull and was inserted into the wall beside him with great force.
